window.title: Strategy Board Import
ui.header: Paste long Strategy Board codes here (one board or several pages). The plugin writes the full string into the in-game import field, so the length limit does not cut it off.
ui.single_import_help: Single import: open Strategy Board → New Strategy → Share Code, then click Import here. Import raw input sends the full text uncut, even if the check cannot decode a name.
ui.folder_import_help: The game has no public folder API. Create or open the folder in Strategy Board (the name is copied to the clipboard). Then open New Strategy → Share Code for each page. The plugin fills the code and confirms it. Saved List: up to {0} boards in total. Folders only group boards; they do not have a separate cap.
ui.import_all_n: Import all {0} boards into a folder
ui.import_all: Import all boards into a folder
ui.no_addons: No visible addons with a text field found.
status.paste_hint: Paste a share code and check it.
status.found_with_decode_errors: {0} share code(s) found. {1} name(s) could not be decoded.
status.copied_all: {0} codes copied to the clipboard. Import them one by one in the share-code window.
command.help: Opens the Strategy Board importer for long share codes.
command.no_code: No share code in the command arguments.
import.no_field: No share-code input field found. In game open Strategy Board → New Strategy → Share Code, then try again.
import.wrote_confirmed: Wrote code ({0} characters) into '{1}' and confirmed it.
import.wrote_manual: Wrote code ({0} characters) into '{1}'. Click Apply/OK in the game window.
folder.saved_list_cap: The Saved List holds at most {0} boards in total. Importing the first {0}.
folder.start: Create or open folder "{0}" (name is on the clipboard). Then New Strategy → Share Code. Page {1}/{2} will be filled automatically.
folder.imported: Imported {0}/{1}: {2}. If the window stays open, click OK in game. Then open New Strategy → Share Code again.
folder.done: Done: {0} boards imported. If they are not in folder "{1}", drag them there in Strategy Board.
folder.waiting: Waiting for the share-code window for page {0}/{1}.
folder.waiting_hint: Open New Strategy → Share Code (not a blank board). The plugin fills the next page when that window is open.
